name: Lysine acetylation and WDR5/MLL-complex histone methylation
rationale: Members concern lysine acetylation of histones, tubulin and other proteins; unlike the acetylation and chromatin-remodeling confusables, the theme adds histone lysine methylation by WDR5-containing KMT2/MLL complexes.

core: Extracellular matrix degradation and protease regulation
name: Extracellular matrix degradation including hyaluronan catabolism
rationale: Members cover breakdown of collagen, elastin and hyaluronan with metalloproteinase activation and endopeptidase control; hyaluronan turnover separates it from fibrinolysis- and collagen-synthesis confusables.

name: Phagosome maturation and its subversion by Mycobacterium tuberculosis
rationale: Members describe phagosome acidification and lysosome fusion and Mtb blockade of these and related host defenses; confusables cover other Mtb or pathogen manipulations (apoptosis, energy metabolism, iron) without the phagosome maturation steps.

qualifier: RB1-E2F repression and G2/M checkpoint control
name: Cell cycle transitions via RB1-E2F repression and G2/M checkpoint
rationale: Members span cyclin-CDK control of G1/S via RB1/E2F and DREAM repression plus G2/M entry and checkpoint events; confusables are APC/C mitotic exit or E2F-target G1/S transcription and proliferation modules.

name: Coagulation cascade and fibrinolysis with factor V defects
rationale: Members cover initiation, common-pathway fibrin formation, clot dissolution and its regulation; the factor V cleavage defects distinguish it from VWF, factor VIII/IX and factor XII contact-pathway confusables.

core: Retinal layer formation and neuron differentiation
qualifier: DSCAM, sidekick and nectin heterophilic adhesion
name: Retinal lamination and DSCAM/sidekick/nectin neuronal adhesion
rationale: Members concern retinal lamination and amacrine/bipolar/photoreceptor differentiation alongside DSCAM, SDK and nectin adhesion and dendrite self-avoidance, unlike L1-family adhesion or photoreceptor-development confusables.

qualifier: arsenite and PKR stress with PML bodies
name: Arsenite-induced stress granule and PML body organization
rationale: Members concern stress granule assembly, disassembly and protein recruitment under arsenite/PKR stress plus PML body organization, unlike proteasomal degradation, mRNA stability or heat-shock confusables.

qualifier: sterol, isoprenoid and very-long-chain/ether lipid synthesis
name: Peroxisome-linked sterol, isoprenoid and very-long-chain lipid synthesis
rationale: Members cover mevalonate/cholesterol synthesis, VLCFA elongation, PUFA and ether lipid metabolism with peroxisome markers; confusables are dominated by peroxisomal beta-oxidation and protein import without sterol synthesis.

name: ERK/MAPK negative feedback and atypical MAPK (ERK3/4/5) signaling
rationale: Members concern ERK inactivation and feedback suppression of MAPK signaling together with ERK5 and MAPK6/MAPK4 cascades, which phosphatase- and JNK/p38-focused confusables lack.

qualifier: TLR signaling by endogenous damage ligands
name: Monocyte inflammatory responses with damage-associated TLR signaling
rationale: Members are monocyte/myeloid modules and inflammatory TLR signaling including heme and endogenous TLR ligands; confusables center on LPS sensing, antigen presentation, SIRP or neutrophil degranulation.

qualifier: gamma-glutamyl cycle inborn errors and cystine transport
name: Glutathione breakdown and gamma-glutamyl cycle inborn errors
rationale: Members cover glutathione degradation and transport, cystine uptake and GGT1/OPLAH/ACY1 deficiencies, distinguishing it from glutathione synthesis, cystinuria transport and ferroptosis confusables.

qualifier: HDL clearance and restraint of cholesterol efflux
name: Sterol homeostasis via HDL clearance and efflux restraint
rationale: Members regulate cellular cholesterol balance through HDL clearance, reverse transport and negative control of efflux and synthesis, unlike SREBP/LDL-uptake or LXR-driven efflux confusables.

name: Resolvin, protectin and maresin pro-resolving mediator biosynthesis
rationale: Members are biosynthesis of resolvins, protectins, maresins and related HETE/oxo-PUFA mediators, distinct from lipoxin, leukotriene and hepoxilin confusables.

name: Microglial activation, proliferation, migration and cytotoxicity
rationale: All members are microglial immune behaviors, whereas confusables concern microglial differentiation with amyloid-beta handling, synaptic maintenance or M-CSF macrophage signaling.

name: Bile acid enterohepatic circulation and biliary sterol ABC transporters
rationale: Members cover bile acid synthesis, secretion, recycling and signaling plus intestinal lipid absorption and ABCB11/ABCB4/ABCG5/ABCG8 defects, unlike HDL/phospholipid efflux or alternative-pathway bile acid synthesis confusables.

name: piRNA-mediated transposon silencing and germline chromatin remodeling
rationale: Members concern piRNA biogenesis and heterochromatin silencing of retroelements with sperm chromatin condensation and germ cell events; germline specification and imprinting confusables lack the piRNA pathway.

core: Wnt and Hedgehog ligand lipidation and secretion
name: Morphogen lipidation and secretion with non-canonical Wnt/Ca2+ signaling
rationale: Members cover PORCN/HHAT lipidation, Hh autoprocessing and Wnt/Hh ligand release plus WNT5A-Ca2+ signaling, unlike generic palmitoylation, canonical Wnt or Hh reception confusables.

qualifier: IL-12 drive and IFN-gamma-induced MHC expression
name: IL-12-driven Th1 differentiation and IFN-gamma-induced MHC expression
rationale: Members cover IL-12/JAK-STAT-driven Th1 differentiation, IFN-gamma response, MHC class I/II regulation and antigen presentation, unlike IFNG-signaling regulation, DC IL-12 production or Treg confusables.

qualifier: imino acid/glycine carriers and proton-coupled oligopeptide transport
name: Imino acid, glycine, neutral amino acid and peptide transport
rationale: Members concern plasma-membrane uptake of proline, glycine, tryptophan and neutral amino acids (SLC6A19/SLC6A20/SLC36A2 disorders) and di/oligopeptides, unlike cationic/branched amino acid or renal urate/cystine confusables.

qualifier: synaptic plasticity and dendritic spine remodeling
name: NMDA receptor-dependent synaptic plasticity and dendritic spine remodeling
rationale: Members cover NMDA receptor activation, downstream Ras/RAC1/AMPK signaling and LTP/LTD and spine plasticity, unlike CREB nuclear-signaling or AMPA/kainate receptor confusables.

name: Retinoid metabolism and retinoic acid biosynthesis
rationale: Members cover retinol, retinal and retinoic acid metabolism and terpenoid chemistry, unlike visual-cycle, retinoic-acid response or CYP26 defect confusables.

name: Regulation of atrial and ventricular cardiomyocyte depolarization
rationale: All members regulate depolarization of atrial or ventricular cardiac muscle cells, unlike nodal/HCN, conduction-system development or repolarization confusables.

name: Viral attachment, entry, protein maturation and virion assembly
rationale: Members span attachment/entry, structural protein maturation and assembly/budding of multiple viruses, whereas confusables cover viral genome replication, transcription, translation or integration.

qualifier: p21-mediated G1 arrest and DNA-damage intrinsic apoptosis
name: p53 regulation, p21-mediated G1 arrest and intrinsic apoptosis
rationale: Members cover TP53 expression/co-factor regulation, p21-driven G1 arrest and p53-promoted intrinsic apoptosis, unlike p14ARF/p16 senescence-evasion or p53 death-gene transcription confusables.

name: Non-oxidative pentose phosphate shunt and alditol/fructose metabolism
rationale: Members cover non-oxidative pentose phosphate interconversions with TALDO1/RPIA defects plus glycerol, alditol and polyol-route fructose metabolism, unlike glycolysis/glycogen, galactose or glucuronate confusables.
